words.example: Please call in sick before seven.
words.exampleZh: 七点前请打电话请病假。

words.example: An unexplained absence is entered as a no-pay day.
words.exampleZh: 没有说明原因的缺勤会被记成无薪缺勤日。

words.example: Repeated tardiness will come up at the monthly staff review.
words.exampleZh: 反复的迟到记录会在月度员工考核时被提出来。

words.example: Absenteeism on Mondays has gone up since the roster changed.
words.exampleZh: 排班调整之后，周一的缺勤上升了。

words.example: Your attendance record is clear except for one late morning.
words.exampleZh: 除了一个迟到的上午，你的出勤记录是干净的。

words.example: Write cache on the array is disabled until the battery holds a charge again.
words.exampleZh: 电池重新蓄上电之前，阵列的写缓存一直关着。

words.example: Read cache on the array is serving the same study films to several viewers.
words.exampleZh: 阵列的读缓存正在把同一份检查影像同时给好几台阅片端。

words.example: The cache battery failed its test, and the array switched itself to write-through.
words.exampleZh: 缓存电池自检没过，阵列自己切到了直写。

words.example: Write-through is slower, but a power loss cannot strand data that was only in cache.
words.exampleZh: 直写更慢，但停电不会把只待在缓存里的数据弄丢。

words.example: Write-back is safe again now that the cache battery holds a full charge.
words.exampleZh: 缓存电池已经充满，回写又安全了。
